lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Nora Gu is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Nora is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d40: 🕯️ Nora Gu is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Nora kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Nora's gone." Victor looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Nora." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Wanyonyi blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d40: 📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Nora Gu, 40 days. The mantle passes to Wanyonyi Ongeri.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Wanyonyi Ongeri, 41 — a crossing guard. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Bird Whisperer, Green Whisper, Lucky Rock.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Beastmaster of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Nora — and Nora is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Lily, Marcus, Dorothy and 5 more speak for Wanyonyi — "Nora trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Wanyonyi before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d72: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d72: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.

lastSay: d111: 📦 A package covered in stickers. The card, in loopy handwriting: "Hope you're doing great! Here's some stuff from home!"
d111: Inside: snacks that taste like purple, a tiny flag, and a photo of someone giving a thumbs-up.
d111: Snow by morning. (-8°C — Freezing) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.
d111: The cold works on everyone — the village wakes aching from the deep cold.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
